title: Characterization and antibacterial effect of green-synthesised silver nanoparticles using different extraction methods from Ziziphus spina-christi (Sidr) leaf extract collected from Syria
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35642-35659
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05214A, Paper
Open Access

Wael Dagher, Abeer Alassod, Mhd Firas Al Hinnawi, Ibrahim Alghoraibi, Amal Taher, Manal Alnhlaoui
The study investigates the effective green biosynthesis of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs) from silver nitrate (AgNO3) as a precursor using Syrian Sidr leaf extract as a reducing and stabilizing agent.
